captions.caption: A person opens a door and a dog runs out into a snowy yard.
A black and grey dog runs through deep snow.
The dog stops and looks around in the snow.
The dog continues running through the snow-covered field.
The dog runs further away from the camera into the snow.
A wide shot of a snowy yard with grain silos in the background.
A blue Polaris ATV is parked in the snow.
The camera pans across the snow-covered rural landscape.
A view of the snowy yard and driveway leading to a building.
A close-up shot of the front of the blue Polaris ATV.
The camera focuses on the handlebars and dashboard of the ATV.
A man in a brown winter jacket and black beanie begins talking.
The man talks about the weather while standing in the snow.
The man continues his monologue in the snowy yard.
The man gestures towards the snowy field behind him.
The man mentions the temperature was 15 below zero yesterday.
The man talks about the wind chill being in the mid-20s below zero.
The man explains why he stayed inside during the extreme cold.
The man looks around the snowy property while speaking.
The man mentions that nothing would start in the cold weather.
The man explains that the four-wheeler wouldn't start yesterday.
The man mentions that the tractor would start because it was inside.
The camera pans to show the garage and the blue ATV.
The man turns the camera back to himself as he continues talking.
The man explains the dangers of being out in the extreme cold.
The man gestures at the vast, snow-covered landscape.
The man mentions how people can die in such cold conditions.
The man explains he wasn't going to mess around with the cold.
The man starts walking through the snow while talking.
The man mentions having to leave town for a hockey game.
The man continues walking and talking in the snowy yard.
The man looks at the camera while walking in the cold.
The man mentions his son's hockey game.
The man walks past several snow-covered evergreen trees.
The man talks about going to Minneapolis for a Vikings game.
The man mentions the Vikings will be playing the Chicago Bears.
The man continues walking through the snow-covered grounds.
The man talks about the nosebleed seats he got for the game.
The man mentions it is the last game of the year.
The man hopes it won't be the last game if they beat Chicago.
The man looks at the camera while discussing the game.
The man continues his walk through the winter scenery.
The man mentions that Chicago has a good team right now.
The man talks about the team's performance while walking.
The man gestures with his hand as he explains the situation.
The man looks around at the snow-covered landscape.
The man continues his walk through the snowy yard.
The man talks about the upcoming game against the Bears.
The man looks directly at the camera while speaking.
The man explains that they can beat them if they show up.
The man mentions the importance of the game for the Vikings.
A text overlay saying "Yeah, Bears Fans, I know." appears.
The man continues talking while the text overlay is visible.
The text overlay remains on the screen as the man speaks.
The man continues his monologue with the text overlay present.
The text overlay disappears as the man keeps walking.
The man mentions that this is a do-or-die situation.
The man says it's going to be a lot of fun either way.
The man continues walking through the deep snow.
The man finishes his thought while walking in the snowy yard.
